evidence.title: What makes a site look "vibe-coded": the data
What makes a site look "vibe-coded": the data

name: vibecoded-design-tells
summary: Reddit-mined study of what makes sites look AI-built, with Claude skills that strip AI slop from UI, writing and code.
description: Three studies that mine public Reddit posts for the tells people use to spot AI-generated sites, prose and code, each shipped with a Claude skill. The UI study scanned 3.2M posts and ranks tells such as shadcn/Tailwind defaults and AI-purple gradients; the unslop-ui skill includes a scanner that gates CI on its exit code.
contains: three Claude skills: unslop-ui, unslop-text, unslop-code
unslop-ui: build and audit modes, ranked tells catalog, devibescan.py scanner that gates CI
raw data: corpus.jsonl.gz, CSV tables, quote banks, 12 charts
python scripts reproduce the harvest and ranking
